blocks.text: ‘No publicist or manager in sight’: Madonna in the 80s, unseen and off-duty – in pictures

In Madonna Into the Groove: An Intimate Portrait of the Queen of Pop , photographer Ken Regan opens his archive from 1985 to show never-before-seen photographs of the musician. The 160-page hardback showcases Madonna at her most vibrant, captured on a February day in Los Angeles, with accompanying biographical text by journalist Tomás Mier. With the majority of images previously unpublished, the book is a behind-the-scenes look at an artist coming into the peak of her powers
